data.name: Elizabeth
data.gender_notes: Elizabeth is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God is my oath; God is abundance
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Elisheva: Eli, 'my God', + sheva, 'oath' or 'seven'. Its root is Hebrew ʾ-l-y-sh-b-ʿ. Elizabeth, mother of John the Baptist (Luke 1). Elizabeth is a Hebrew name meaning “God is my oath; God is abundance”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Elizabeth expresses “God is my oath; God is abundance”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Elisheva: Eli, 'my God', + sheva, 'oath' or 'seven'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elizabeth total 43, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
